drawbacks.title: Model Profitability Below Cost Gate — No Deployable Model
evidence: retraining_audit_20260607_212417: 0/82 models pass cost_1.5x_pf >= 1.0. Best: hist_gradient_boosting PF=1.29
unseen_holdout_paper_trade_20260607_076000: Best holdout PF=0.908, Sharpe=-0.532, all 5 configs fail
drawbacks.fix_plan: Retrain with larger train window, improve feature engineering, or adjust label definition — do NOT lower cost gate threshold

drawbacks.title: Paper Readiness BLOCKED
evidence: paper_readiness_report_20260607_212137: decision=BLOCKED, full_run_completed=true, best_partial PF=1.0 with only 36 trades
drawbacks.fix_plan: Resolve why no model passes paper readiness before live/paper trading is considered

drawbacks.title: max_daily_loss Does Not Include Unrealized MTM
evidence: risk_control_audit_20260607_144741.md Gap 1: _risk_status() only checks realized_pnl; open position losses are NOT counted
drawbacks.fix_plan: Add unrealized_pnl to daily loss calculation, called at every tick/loop iteration

drawbacks.title: opening_max_move_pct Too Tight (0.40%)
evidence: risk_control_audit_20260607_144741.md Gap 4: 0.40% (~40-50 NIFTY pts) blocks all entries on trending open days for 45 min
drawbacks.fix_plan: Relax opening_max_move_pct to 0.75-1.0% for NIFTY options scalping

drawbacks.title: No External Kill-Switch Env Var
evidence: risk_control_audit_20260607_144741.md Gap 5: no MSTOCK_KILL_SWITCH env var to halt trading without code restart
drawbacks.fix_plan: Add MSTOCK_KILL_SWITCH=1 check at top of run_forever and _decide_entries

drawbacks.title: winrate_tracker_enabled Default False
evidence: risk_control_audit_20260607_144741.md Gap 6: _strategy_winrate_check() streak protection available but disabled
drawbacks.fix_plan: Enable winrate_tracker with conservative defaults (3 consecutive losses -> 5min cooldown)

drawbacks.title: max_daily_loss Default May Be Too Tight
evidence: risk_control_audit_20260607_144741.md: Rs5000 for main mode vs Rs500 for micro-live; 1 lot at 65*100=6500 max premium vs 5000 loss limit
drawbacks.fix_plan: Review max_daily_loss=7500 for main mode, keep Rs500 for micro-live

positive_findings.item: Broker safety: All 13 tests PASS (JWT expiry, rate-limit backoff, order polling, fail-closed token guard)
Real trading gate: All 17 tests PASS. Real orders blocked by default behind 13+ conditions
Micro-live mode has separate gate with probability>=0.70, max 1 lot, max daily loss Rs500
15 risk controls implemented (9 fully, 4 partially, 2 conditionally). No critical missing controls
